question: What mitigations does ATT&CK list for T1021.001 (Remote Desktop Protocol)?

answer.headline: Gathered 1 record(s) from 1 source(s).
answer.narrative: MITRE ATT&CK lists eight mitigations for T1021.001 (Remote Desktop Protocol). These include Limit Access to Resource Over Network (M1035), Operating System Configuration (M1028), Network Segmentation (M1030), User Account Management (M1018), Privileged Account Management (M1026), Multi-factor Authentication (M1032), Audit (M1047), and Disable or Remove Feature or Program (M1042).
